tasks.title: Add model control foundation
tasks.description: Introduce the shared model-control primitives used by this change: issue override input shape, model ID validation, and the executable model-stage list `explore`, `plan`, `build`, `check`, `integrate`. Update `resolveStageModel` so it accepts optional issue-level overrides and applies the required fallback chain without changing existing global-only callers.
acceptanceCriteria: resolveStageModel returns issue stage override before issue default, global stage override, and global default
resolveStageModel preserves existing global stage/default behavior when no issue override is provided
Model ID validation accepts provider/model strings and rejects strings without a provider/model separator
The shared executable model-stage list contains integrate and does not contain fix
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep the public resolver simple: callers provide `{ model, stageModels }` when an issue is available. If a separate validation/constants module is added, keep it small and shared by backend callers that need it.

tasks.title: Persist issue stage model overrides
tasks.description: Add nullable per-issue stage model storage to SQLite and carry it through the issue repository and service layer. New and existing issue reads should expose `stageModels`, while create and update paths should persist `model` and `stageModels` without materializing fallback defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Database migration adds `issues.stage_models TEXT DEFAULT NULL` if the column is missing
Fresh database initialization creates an issues table compatible with both `model` and `stage_models` fields
IssueRepo maps valid `stage_models` JSON to `issue.stageModels` and malformed JSON to no overrides
IssueRepo create/update can set, replace, and clear per-issue `stageModels`
IssueService create/update types accept `model` and `stageModels` metadata
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Also update `packages/cli/src/db/issue-repo.ts`, `packages/cli/src/services/issue-service.ts`, and `packages/cli/src/types/index.ts`. Normalize empty stage model maps to null where practical.

tasks.title: Expose issue model metadata through API
tasks.description: Extend issue create, update, and detail API flows to accept and return issue model metadata. Validate `model` and `stageModels` at the HTTP boundary using the shared provider/model format rules, then pass validated data through the existing issue service and repository paths.
acceptanceCriteria: POST /api/issues accepts `model` and returns the created issue with that model
POST /api/issues accepts `stageModels` and returns the created issue with those stage overrides
PATCH /api/issues/:number can set, replace, and clear `stageModels`
PATCH /api/issues/:number rejects invalid model and stage model values with 400 responses
GET /api/issues/:number and issue list responses include `stageModels` when present
Existing issue create/update behavior for title, body, labels, priority, and model remains compatible
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Do not validate model IDs against live discovery results. Shape and provider/model format validation is sufficient.

tasks.title: Apply issue-aware model resolution to agent sessions
tasks.description: Wire issue-level model metadata into every issue-bound coder session path. Normal workflow stages should resolve by the current issue stage, while conflict-resolution and build-error-fix sessions should resolve using build-stage policy with the same issue overrides.
acceptanceCriteria: WorkflowEngine passes `issue.model` and `issue.stageModels` into resolveStageModel for normal stage execution
An issue-level default model overrides global stage and global default models during workflow execution
An issue-level stage model overrides issue default and global settings for that stage
Conflict-resolution sessions use issue-aware build-stage model resolution
Build-error-fix sessions use issue-aware build-stage model resolution
When no issue override or global model is configured, agent session model remains undefined so opencode default applies
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Also update `packages/cli/src/services/conflict-resolution.ts` and `packages/cli/src/server/index.ts`. Keep real ACP model passing unchanged.

tasks.title: Replace ACP model discovery with CLI discovery
tasks.spec: specs/agent-runtime/spec.md#Model discovery does not create opencode sessions
tasks.description: Change opencode model discovery so it runs `opencode models` and parses stdout instead of creating an ACP session. Preserve the existing public discovery service behavior for callers while increasing the cache TTL to 30 minutes.
acceptanceCriteria: OpencodeDiscoveryService no longer spawns `opencode acp` for model discovery
OpencodeDiscoveryService does not call ACP initialize or newSession when listing models
Discovery parses provider/model lines from `opencode models` output into the same string format returned today
Discovery cache is considered fresh for 30 minutes
Discovery failures are logged and surfaced to callers as errors
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use the model ID parsing/validation behavior from T-001 to avoid accepting unrelated CLI output lines.

tasks.title: Add issue-level stage model controls to Web UI
tasks.spec: specs/web-ui/spec.md#Web UI supports issue model overrides
tasks.description: Extend the frontend issue model flow so users can set an issue default model and optional per-stage overrides. The Issue Detail selector should keep the existing simple model selection, add an advanced expandable per-stage section, and Settings should use the corrected stage list.
acceptanceCriteria: Frontend Issue type and API client carry `stageModels` through get, create, and update calls
Issue Detail displays current issue default model and can clear it back to inherited defaults
Issue Detail advanced section can set and clear per-stage overrides for explore, plan, build, check, and integrate
Issue Detail stage override UI does not include fix and does include integrate
Settings Stage Model Overrides list does not include fix and does include integrate
Create Issue dialog can preset an optional issue-level default model
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Add regression tests for model override behavior
tasks.description: Add focused tests covering model precedence, issue metadata persistence/API behavior, and discovery not using ACP sessions. These tests should prove the original disconnected `issue.model` bug is fixed and protect the per-stage fallback chain.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover resolveStageModel precedence for issue stage, issue default, global stage, global default, and undefined fallback
Tests cover IssueRepo or API create/update/get behavior for `stageModels` set, replace, and clear
Tests cover invalid model and stage model API payloads returning validation errors
Tests cover discovery invoking `opencode models` rather than ACP newSession
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Use existing test conventions under `packages/cli/tests`. If frontend test infrastructure is absent, verify frontend via typecheck/build rather than adding a new test stack.

tasks.title: Run final verification for model override change
tasks.description: Run the repository verification commands after backend, discovery, frontend, and tests are implemented. Fix any regressions introduced by the change while preserving the intended fallback behavior and UI flow.
acceptanceCriteria: packages/cli test suite passes
packages/cli build or typecheck passes
No task remains with obsolete references to the nonexistent fix model stage
No model discovery path creates ACP sessions just to list models
Existing persisted `issue.model` values are used by issue-bound coder sessions
tasks.notes: This is the integration gate for the change. Prefer `npm test` and `npm run build` from `packages/cli` unless project scripts indicate a narrower equivalent.
